Sam (People Ops): Putting a concise preboard + day1/day7 + 30/60/90 checklist here. One pager managers can copy into calendar & docs.

Lina: Nice. Can we add a security/compliance quick step?

Sam (People Ops): Yes 12: Security briefing (15m) within first 3 days, and local data access signed. See below.

Marcus: Remote hires need a 'white-glove' option (IT screenshare). Include it as optional.

Sam (People Ops): Done. Also added an explicit owner for escalations.

DevOpsBot: Laptop: order processed. Asset tag pending.

Sam (People Ops): Single-page copy: 

PREBOARD (week before) - ~20min
- Send welcome + logistics + buddy name + location/remote setup preference
- Open access tickets: Okta, Slack, GitHub team, Drive, cloud role, badge request
- Schedule: Day1 9:30 manager 1:1, Team intro, Buddy pairing, Security brief (15m)
- Reserve IT white-glove slot if remote

DAY1 (avoid >4 meetings)
09:300:30 Manager 1:1: role, 90-day outcomes (share KPIs), initial expectations
11:000:30 Team intro: 2-min intros + org map (record)
14:000:30 Buddy: env + run-first-app + first PR pairing
16:300:45 Manager pulse + confirm access

DAY2-5
- 15min daily sync (live or async) to clear blockers
- Schedule security brief and HR benefits session by day3

ACCESS + ESCALATION
- Okta/Slack: @it-support
- GitHub org: @dev-platform
- Cloud roles: @infra-ops
- Badge/bldg access: Facilities (facilities@redwood.com)
- If blocked >8hrs: DM Sam and cc your lead

WHITE-GLOVE OPTION
- IT can screenshare setup (VPN, package install). Managers book via @it-support with subject "white-glove {name}"

DAY7 MANAGER CHECKPOINT (3 items)
- Confirm new hire merged or opened first PR with buddy help
- Buddy confirms dev env + tests pass
- Manager gave 30-day feedback & set immediate priority

30/60/90 (with simple KPIs)
- 30d: onboarded - KPI: merged PR and 2 cross-team intros completed
- 60d: owns a feature/bug end-to-end - KPI: feature deployed to staging + runbook updated
- 90d: leads a small project - KPI: measurable impact (bug reduction, latency, docs)

SAMPLE TEMPLATES
Manager welcome email:
"Hi {name}, welcome to Team X. Buddy is {buddy}. Day1 9:300:30 manager 1:1. Attached: 3 priority outcomes. LMK if you need a white-glove IT slot."

Slack intro:
"Welcome {name} to Team X as {role}! Buddy: {buddy}. Fun fact: {one-liner} :tada:"

Priya: Love the KPIs. Please put a one-pager in the onboarding repo and link it here.
